title: Structure your Seedance prompt with explicit timecoded beats (e.g…
content:
Structure your Seedance prompt with explicit timecoded beats (e.g., [0:00–0:02], [0:02–0:04]) to force specific actions, shot types, and SFX at each moment.

Specify a single continuous motion constraint (e.g., “one continuous forward flowing path—never stops moving forward”) to keep the character’s trajectory consistent across the whole clip.

Use an uploaded character sheet as a strict visual reference and restate key identity traits (skin tone, hair, build, outfit) to lock character consistency.

Call out a recurring visual anchor (e.g., “pink sneakers prominent on every landing”) to keep a specific prop/detail consistently emphasized across cuts.

Direct camera/editing behavior in the prompt (e.g., “fast cuts from frame one,” “never same angle twice,” “side tracking,” “low angle,” “overhead,” “wide shot,” “close-up”) to control shot variety and pacing.

Include per-beat sound design instructions (e.g., “high energy beat from frame one,” “footsteps and impact sounds always audible,” “movement synced to the beat”) to drive audio timing and intensity.

Add explicit environment/action interactions (vault barrier, run on scooters, bounce off awning, wall run, petals exploding) to increase dynamism and ensure the scene reacts to movement.

Define the final frame/ending composition (e.g., “ends on wide shot rooftop hero moment”) to control how the video resolves.

Lock the visual style with concrete render keywords (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, bright midday natural lighting, film grain, heavy shadows) and include negative style constraints (not Disney/Pixar/cartoon) to avoid unwanted aesthetics.

es.content:
Estructura tu prompt de Seedance con beats explícitos con marca de tiempo (por ejemplo, [0:00–0:02], [0:02–0:04]) para forzar acciones específicas, tipos de plano y SFX en cada momento.

Especifica una única restricción de movimiento continuo (por ejemplo, “one continuous forward flowing path—never stops moving forward”) para mantener la trayectoria del personaje consistente durante todo el clip.

Usa una character sheet subida como referencia visual estricta y vuelve a mencionar los rasgos clave de identidad (tono de piel, cabello, complexión, vestuario) para fijar la consistencia del personaje.

Señala un ancla visual recurrente (por ejemplo, “pink sneakers prominent on every landing”) para mantener un detalle/prop específico enfatizado de forma consistente entre cortes.

Dirige el comportamiento de cámara/edición en el prompt (por ejemplo, “fast cuts from frame one,” “never same angle twice,” “side tracking,” “low angle,” “overhead,” “wide shot,” “close-up”) para controlar la variedad de planos y el ritmo.

Incluye instrucciones de sound design por beat (por ejemplo, “high energy beat from frame one,” “footsteps and impact sounds always audible,” “movement synced to the beat”) para guiar la sincronización y la intensidad del audio.

Añade interacciones explícitas entre el entorno y la acción (vault barrier, run on scooters, bounce off awning, wall run, petals exploding) para aumentar la dinamismo y asegurar que la escena reaccione al movimiento.

Define la composición del frame final/el cierre (por ejemplo, “ends on wide shot rooftop hero moment”) para controlar cómo se resuelve el video.

Bloquea el estilo visual con keywords concretas de render (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, bright midday natural lighting, film grain, heavy shadows) e incluye restricciones negativas de estilo (not Disney/Pixar/cartoon) para evitar estéticas no deseadas.

fr.content:
Structurez votre prompt Seedance avec des beats explicites horodatés (par ex. [0:00–0:02], [0:02–0:04]) afin d’imposer des actions, des types de plans et des SFX précis à chaque moment.

Spécifiez une contrainte de mouvement continu unique (par ex. « one continuous forward flowing path—never stops moving forward ») pour maintenir une trajectoire cohérente du personnage sur toute la durée du clip.

Utilisez une character sheet téléversée comme référence visuelle stricte et reformulez les traits d’identité clés (teint, cheveux, morphologie, tenue) afin de verrouiller la cohérence du personnage.

Mettez en avant un repère visuel récurrent (par ex. « pink sneakers prominent on every landing ») pour garder un élément/prop spécifique constamment mis en valeur à travers les cuts.

Décrivez le comportement de la caméra et du montage dans le prompt (par ex. « fast cuts from frame one », « never same angle twice », « side tracking », « low angle », « overhead », « wide shot », « close-up ») afin de contrôler la variété des plans et le rythme.

Ajoutez des instructions de sound design pour chaque beat (par ex. « high energy beat from frame one », « footsteps and impact sounds always audible », « movement synced to the beat ») pour piloter le timing et l’intensité audio.

Ajoutez des interactions explicites entre l’environnement et l’action (vault barrier, run on scooters, bounce off awning, wall run, petals exploding) pour accroître le dynamisme et garantir que la scène réagisse au mouvement.

Définissez la composition du dernier frame/de la fin (par ex. « ends on wide shot rooftop hero moment ») pour contrôler la manière dont la vidéo se conclut.

Verrouillez le style visuel avec des mots-clés de rendu concrets (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, bright midday natural lighting, film grain, heavy shadows) et ajoutez des contraintes de style négatives (not Disney/Pixar/cartoon) afin d’éviter des esthétiques indésirables.

ja.content:
Seedanceのpromptは、明示的なタイムコード付きのビート（例: [0:00–0:02], [0:02–0:04]）で構成し、各瞬間における具体的なアクション、ショットタイプ、SFXを強制します。

単一の連続したモーション制約（例: “one continuous forward flowing path—never stops moving forward”）を指定して、クリップ全体を通してキャラクターの軌道が一貫するようにします。

アップロードしたキャラクターシートを厳密なビジュアル参照として使用し、主要なアイデンティティ要素（肌の色、髪型、体格、衣装）を改めて明記して、キャラクターの一貫性を固定します。

繰り返し登場するビジュアルアンカー（例: “pink sneakers prominent on every landing”）を指定して、特定の小道具やディテールがカットをまたいでも一貫して強調されるようにします。

prompt内でカメラ／編集の挙動を指示し（例: “fast cuts from frame one,” “never same angle twice,” “side tracking,” “low angle,” “overhead,” “wide shot,” “close-up”）、ショットの多様性とテンポをコントロールします。

ビートごとのサウンドデザイン指示（例: “high energy beat from frame one,” “footsteps and impact sounds always audible,” “movement synced to the beat”）を含めて、音のタイミングと強度を演出します。

明確な環境／アクションの相互作用（vault barrier, run on scooters, bounce off awning, wall run, petals exploding）を追加してダイナミズムを高め、シーンが動きに反応するようにします。

最終フレーム／エンディングの構図（例: “ends on wide shot rooftop hero moment”）を定義して、動画の締め方をコントロールします。

具体的なレンダーキーワード（cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, bright midday natural lighting, film grain, heavy shadows）でビジュアルスタイルを固定し、不要な美学を避けるためにネガティブなスタイル制約（not Disney/Pixar/cartoon）も含めます。

ko.content:
Seedance prompt를 각 순간마다 명시적인 타임코드 비트([0:00–0:02], [0:02–0:04] 등)로 구성해, 각 시점마다 특정 동작, 샷 타입, SFX를 강제하세요.

하나의 연속적인 모션 제약(예: “one continuous forward flowing path—never stops moving forward”)을 지정해 캐릭터의 궤적이 클립 전체에서 일관되게 유지되도록 하세요.

업로드한 character sheet를 엄격한 비주얼 레퍼런스로 사용하고, 핵심 정체성 특징(피부 톤, 머리카락, 체형, 의상)을 다시 명시해 캐릭터 일관성을 고정하세요.

반복적으로 등장하는 시각적 앵커(예: “pink sneakers prominent on every landing”)를 지정해 특정 소품/디테일이 컷 전반에서 지속적으로 강조되도록 하세요.

prompt 안에서 카메라/편집 동작을 직접 지시하세요(예: “fast cuts from frame one,” “never same angle twice,” “side tracking,” “low angle,” “overhead,” “wide shot,” “close-up”) — 샷의 다양성과 페이싱을 제어하기 위해서입니다.

비트별 사운드 디자인 지시를 포함하세요(예: “high energy beat from frame one,” “footsteps and impact sounds always audible,” “movement synced to the beat”) — 오디오 타이밍과 강도를 이끌어내기 위해서입니다.

명시적인 환경/행동 상호작용을 추가하세요(vault barrier, run on scooters, bounce off awning, wall run, petals exploding) — 역동성을 높이고 장면이 움직임에 반응하도록 하기 위해서입니다.

최종 프레임/엔딩 구도를 정의하세요(예: “ends on wide shot rooftop hero moment”) — 영상이 어떻게 마무리되는지 제어하기 위해서입니다.

구체적인 render 키워드(cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, bright midday natural lighting, film grain, heavy shadows)로 비주얼 스타일을 고정하고, 원치 않는 미학을 피하기 위해 negative style constraints(not Disney/Pixar/cartoon)도 포함하세요.

pt.content:
Estruture seu prompt do Seedance com beats explícitos com marcação de tempo (por exemplo, [0:00–0:02], [0:02–0:04]) para forçar ações específicas, tipos de plano e SFX em cada momento.

Especifique uma única restrição de movimento contínuo (por exemplo, “one continuous forward flowing path—never stops moving forward”) para manter a trajetória do personagem consistente ao longo de todo o clipe.

Use uma character sheet enviada como referência visual rigorosa e reafirme os principais traços de identidade (tom de pele, cabelo, porte físico, roupa) para travar a consistência do personagem.

Mencione um elemento visual recorrente de destaque (por exemplo, “pink sneakers prominent on every landing”) para manter um detalhe/objeto específico sempre enfatizado entre os cortes.

Direcione o comportamento de câmera/edição no prompt (por exemplo, “fast cuts from frame one,” “never same angle twice,” “side tracking,” “low angle,” “overhead,” “wide shot,” “close-up”) para controlar a variedade de planos e o ritmo.

Inclua instruções de sound design por beat (por exemplo, “high energy beat from frame one,” “footsteps and impact sounds always audible,” “movement synced to the beat”) para conduzir o timing e a intensidade do áudio.

Adicione interações explícitas entre ambiente e ação (vault barrier, run on scooters, bounce off awning, wall run, petals exploding) para aumentar a dinamismo e garantir que a cena reaja ao movimento.

Defina a composição do frame final/encerramento (por exemplo, “ends on wide shot rooftop hero moment”) para controlar como o vídeo se resolve.

Trave o estilo visual com palavras-chave concretas de render (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, bright midday natural lighting, film grain, heavy shadows) e inclua restrições negativas de estilo (not Disney/Pixar/cartoon) para evitar estéticas indesejadas.

zh.content:
用明确的时间码节拍来构建你的 Seedance prompt（例如，[0:00–0:02]、[0:02–0:04]），以强制每个时刻出现特定动作、镜头类型和 SFX。

指定一个单一、连续的运动约束（例如，“one continuous forward flowing path—never stops moving forward”），以保持角色在整个片段中的轨迹一致。

使用上传的角色设定表作为严格的视觉参考，并重申关键身份特征（肤色、发型、体型、服装），以锁定角色一致性。

指出一个重复出现的视觉锚点（例如，“pink sneakers prominent on every landing”），以便在不同镜头切换中持续突出某个特定道具/细节。

在 prompt 中直接指明镜头/剪辑行为（例如，“fast cuts from frame one,” “never same angle twice,” “side tracking,” “low angle,” “overhead,” “wide shot,” “close-up”），以控制镜头多样性和节奏。

加入按节拍划分的 sound design 指令（例如，“high energy beat from frame one,” “footsteps and impact sounds always audible,” “movement synced to the beat”），以驱动音频时序和强度。

添加明确的环境/动作互动（vault barrier、run on scooters、bounce off awning、wall run、petals exploding），以增强动态感，并确保场景会对运动产生反应。

定义最终画面/结尾构图（例如，“ends on wide shot rooftop hero moment”），以控制视频如何收束。

用具体的渲染关键词锁定视觉风格（cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime、semi-realistic CGI、hand-painted textures、Unreal Engine quality、bright midday natural lighting、film grain、heavy shadows），并加入负面风格限制（not Disney/Pixar/cartoon），以避免不想要的美学效果。
